enrichment.headline: Lets The Watershed Project install a rainwater cistern, trees and mural at Coliseum College Prep at no cost
enrichment.summary: Under this memorandum of understanding (MOU), The Watershed Project would build a rainwater harvesting cistern, plant new California native trees, add redwood benches and a planter, and paint a mural on a bungalow at Coliseum College Preparatory Academy, at no cost to the District. The District agrees to maintain the plantings and other installations, and the nonprofit will keep the cistern in good condition with yearly campus check-ups. The agreement runs from December 1, 2023 through December 31, 2034.
